_about: Business settings the policy owner controls. Changing the region, segment thresholds or territories means editing this file, not the code.

segment._rule: Enterprise needs a trusted Apollo match AND (HQ outside the region with at least out_of_region_min_employees, OR at least any_region_min_employees). Everything else is Mid-Market.

evidence_words._about: Equipment and facility words. The scraper copies a short snippet around each hit on the homepage and subpages, so evidence deep in a page is not lost to the text cap. They only choose what text the grader sees; they decide nothing.

territories._about: How territories are built. method 'marquee': one territory per marquee customer; each Fit goes to the nearest marquee account within radius_miles. Give each marquee account as a CRM account_id (location comes from the CRM) or with lat/lon. method 'state': one territory per state in region_states; radius and anchors are ignored. target_per_territory is a book-size goal used to report shortfall; it never removes an in-range Fit. The example's marquee accounts are made up, at real ZIP codes. balance: even out the books (fits count equally); contested fits go to the shorter book, and short books may claim unclaimed fits within stretch_radius_miles.
